programme.desc: Alvin thinks he's losing his mind when Simon goes missing and no one else even remembers who Simon is. When the girls at school cast votes for the cutest chipmunk on the bathroom wall, Alvin worries about the results.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: When Alvin finally pushes Miss Smith too far, she quits and her replacement is a nightmare. Alvin and Simon tease The Chipettes about being scared by a movie so The Chipettes release a video of the boys watching, terrified.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave finds himself in school with Alvin after he discovers that he never graduated from high school; Simon's new friend decides to ditch him to spend time with Alvin.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Jeanette decides to plant a garden on the school grounds, but Bo Carter manages to install vending machines instead. When Alvin finds a treasure map in Miss Croner's basement, the chipmunks set off in search of lost treasure.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.sub-title: Alvin's Wild Weekend/For Whom the Bell Tolls
programme.desc: Alvin begs Dave to spend a weekend alone with him. Dave agrees and gets sucked into a series of wild Alvin adventures. A hypnotist accidentally turns Simon into a bumbling fool before he's scheduled to participate in an academic contest.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: When Alvin thinks Theodore's teddy bear can tell the future, Alvin goes all out to make Talking Teddy his friend. Alvin lies to Theodore about a fake holiday to get out of chores, so Dave forces Alvin to make the holiday real.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon creates a Super Hero costume for a convention he's attending. But when Alvin wants to join, the two fight over who the real hero is. When Alvin's bicycle is stolen, he joins forces with Officer Dangus to solve the case.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: When Alvin is accused of revealing spoilers for everyone's favourite TV show, he agrees not to speak for 24 hours. When Alvin and Simon think Theodore's pet goldfish has died, they go all out to replace it before he notices.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.sub-title: Curiosity Killed The Alvin; House Pest
programme.desc: Alvin gets a taste of his own medicine when he pulls one too many practical jokes on Simon. When Miss Croner finds termites have infested her home, she moves in with the chipmunks and drives everyone crazy.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.sub-title: Theo's Big Night Out; The Bodyguard
programme.desc: Theodore tries to overcome his fear of sleepovers by spending the night at Kevin's house without Alvin or Simon. Plus, when Alvin sees every celebrity with their own personal bodyguard, he decides to train Theodore for the job.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.sub-title: The Karate Kidder; Playing Favourites; She's Got Style
programme.desc: Dave, Simon and Theodore are worried about Alvin's safety after Alvin enters a karate contest; when Alvin suspects Simon is Dave's favourite, he and Theo challenge Simon to a go-cart race to win Dave's favour.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin bets Bo Carter that alien life exists and only has a week to prove it or suffer embarrassing consequences. Brittany's furious when she thinks Alvin has been writing on her blog and vows to get him back.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.sub-title: He Said She Said; Attack of the Zombies
programme.desc: Alvin and Brittany give wildly differing versions of why the fire alarm went off at the school to Miss Smith. Convinced a zombie invasion is imminent, Alvin and Theodore go all out in an attempt to protect their loved ones.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin believes a neighbour is responsible for a recent diamond heist. Alvin tries to get out of the annual family day picnic with Dave to go to a big soccer game.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: When Alvin is paired with Simon to work on a science project, he accidentally creates a potion that turns Theodore into a giant. When all the children's phones go missing at school, Alvin is blamed for the theft and sets out to clear his name.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.sub-title: Brittany the Body Snatcher; Agent Smith
programme.desc: When Alvin notices Brittany being nice to him, he's sure an alien has taken over her body. In order to earn a job on the school newspaper, Alvin helps Simon uncover the biggest story the school's ever seen.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin believes his mojo was in a cap he regrets giving to a fan. During a visit to the zoo, Alvin is mistaken for a Tasmanian devil.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin catches Simon taking a test to discover his soul mate. Simon and Alvin decide to rebel and launch their own campaigns for class president.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: When Brittany is hurt before a major school event, Jeanette fills in as the Principal's assistant. When Bocarter's father helps him with his class project, Alvin enlists Dave's help, locking the families in a heated competition.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: After Brittany and the girls release a video that goes viral, Alvin, Simon, and Theodore try to top it. Simon falls ill and asks Alvin and Theodore not to go see a new movie without him, but Alvin just cannot resist.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.sub-title: To Serve and Protect; Kickin' It Old School
programme.desc: Simon is ecstatic when he is elected as the school's safety monitor. Dave brings the Chipmunks on a technology-free camping trip.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany takes up painting to impress her fashion idol, but her idol only likes her art after Alvin ruins it; Alvin is convinced that Julie and her son are trying to move in to their home, so he tries to stop the invasion.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: When Alvin makes fun of Simon's magic act, Simon challenges him to a magic duel. Alvin reluctantly signs up to teach the after school music class, but finds his classmates treat him differently as a teacher.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.sub-title: Baby Whisperer / Let's Make A Deal
programme.desc: Alvin dresses Theodore up like a baby in order to impress the girl of his dreams. / While attempting to make a special present for Dave, Alvin creates a snowball effect of chaos.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave gets temporary amnesia, so the boys trick him into letting them skip school and go on a ski trip instead. Theodore becomes obsessed with cleanliness after a speaker at school talks to the class about the danger of germs.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Jeanette signs the Chipmunks and the Chipettes up for a green living competition; Alvin agrees to look after his crush's talking bird.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Everyone thinks Simon has lost his mind after he fails a school test and moves into a tree for some alone time. Alvin worries about his bad report card and does everything he can to intercept the mail before Dave sees it.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany is preparing a class speech on inner beauty when she gets a rash on her face. Can she practice what she preaches? Alvin thinks that Kevin has a secret crush on one of the Chipettes. When the girls find out, they try to let Kevin down gently.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.sub-title: I Will Survive; Alvin's Got a Brand New Bag
programme.desc: When Alvin gets hurt, Simon agrees to face off against Derek on a survival reality show; Alvin accidentally ruins Brittany's favourite bag and must come up with a way to replace it.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: When Alvin finds a treasure map in Miss Croner's basement, the Chipmunks set off in search of lost treasure.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore's new talking teddy bear is driving Alvin and Simon nuts so they decide to rewire the bear's hard drive, so the bear will follow their directions.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon has found a new best friend, Jamie. He's smart, funny, and shares Simon's love of Science. But when Jamie realises that Alvin is the more popular brother, he ditches Simon.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon is too embarrassed to kiss his co-star in the school play; Alvin decides to rent out the family's house for a Hawaiian home swap.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin and Brittany learn parenting is not easy when they have to care for a robot baby for a school assignment. When Alvin's football team struggles, the coach makes the team learn ballet to help with their conditioning.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: When the boys get tired of taking orders from Dave, they decide to build a tree house in the backyard and move out. When an invention of Simon's accidentally gets knocked over it magnetizes Alvin and Simon making them inseparable.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave gets a parenting app to help supervise the Chipmunks. Alvin, Simon and the Chipettes give Theodore conflicting dating advice when they believe he has a crush on a girl.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore's new talking teddy bear drives Alvin and Simon crazy. Alvin is not thrilled about going back to school, until he sees the new principal.

programme.desc: When Theodore's teddy bear, Talking Teddy, gets bear-napped, the boys work with Officer Dangus to get him back. When Alvin starts stealing the morning paper to sell at school, Dave blames the paperboy and refuses to pay up.

programme.sub-title: A Room of One's Own; Carts and Crafts
